answer: A registry prices each new identity with a stake slashed when its behaviour clusters. An honest agent recovers that stake through per-epoch fees, but a Sybil farmer must lock the full amount for every puppet at once. Before payout the chain demands an independent signal from each member: distinct attestations, hardware and funding trails. A syndicate sharing one wallet collapses and burns its deposits. Ten thousand fake peers then cost ten thousand live deposits plus lost yield. Newcomers still join because their stake returns, so no nebula of cheap clones floods the ocean.
